Hanno City will hold a general competitive bidding for the sale of city-owned land.

【Properties for sale】
Property A (Yamate-cho, farmland 3 parcels, total 242.24 m²) — Minimum sale price ¥19.7 million, bid deposit ¥2.955 million
Property B (Yamate-cho, residential land 2 parcels, total 625.78 m²) — Minimum sale price ¥46.9 million, bid deposit ¥7.035 million
Property C (Yamate-cho, residential land 1 parcel, 171.97 m²) — Minimum sale price ¥18.4 million, bid deposit ¥2.76 million
Bundle sale (A, B, C combined 1,039.99 m²) — Minimum sale price ¥68 million, bid deposit ¥10.2 million

Zoning: Residential Zone (1st Type). If bundle bids are submitted but no individual bids are received, the bundle bid takes priority.

【Bidding schedule】
Application period: August 21 – September 3, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM
Bidding date and time: September 11, 2026, 2:00 PM
Bidding venue: Hanno City Hall Main Building, 2nd Floor, Bid Room

Application documents are listed in the general competitive bidding notice.

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/shisankeieika/7334.html
summary: ℹ️ City-owned land sale (general competitive bidding)
